Filling out your automatic thought journal now feels more like a session with a psychologist. With “Gentle Dialogue,” you can simply describe what happened in your own words—your AI assistant will gently guide you and fill in the necessary journal steps for you. This allows you to focus on your memories, thoughts, and feelings in the moment without worrying about the journal’s structure.
